design_status: Fixed before new simulation runs; not formally blinded. Search previews already exposed some water-tension numbers and qualitative wake observations. No parameter will be fitted to them.

water.model: TIP4P/2005 rigid water, selected in the preceding topology-method task; original parameters, no adjustment
water.geometry: periodic liquid slab with two vapor interfaces; orthorhombic cell; PME electrostatics and LJPME dispersion
water.primary: at least two independently seeded runs, nominal lateral size 2.5 nm, z box 8 nm, 2 fs timestep; 100 ps bulk plus 200 ps slab equilibration then 300 ps sampling
water.controls: 1 fs timestep, larger lateral box, area-strain sensitivity; retain unsuccessful or poorly sampled cases
water.observables: density profile, graph-based psi distribution and coverage; molecular-center test-area free-energy surface tension with two-interface normalization
water.topology: Use existing classifier unchanged. Analyze complete graph before grouping by planar depth. Planar bins are not ITIM layers.
water.comparison: New-to-this-project published experimental pure-water surface tension; score all chosen matched-temperature rows. Numerical water topology populations have no direct experimental validation here.
water.uncertainty: time-block variability and between-seed agreement, not independent-molecule standard errors; small-box/short-trajectory limitations retained

flow.model: three-dimensional D3Q19 lattice-Boltzmann, fixed no-slip sphere/oblate body, incompressible low-Mach limit; regularized collision with optional fixed Smagorinsky Cs=0.1 for underresolved high-Re flow
flow.scope: External gas flow only. No VOF, internal liquid circulation, evolving shape, particle capture or retention claim.
flow.primary: Re_D=1500 and 2500; fixed aspect ratio 0.7, spherical control; grid, Mach/time and domain sensitivity
flow.geometry_convention: D volume-equivalent diameter; axis ratio streamwise/transverse; area convention explicit
flow.numerical_checks: equilibrium preservation, shear-wave decay and low-Re body control; density/mass, max velocity and force history; grid/domain differences
flow.experimental_comparison: Seek a new primary falling-drop experiment with geometry and terminal speed; compare computed gas drag with weight-minus-buoyancy inferred from measured terminal conditions, or a directly reported wake observable. Existing Hong, Lemaitre, Querel, Depee and Jones lineage are development evidence.
flow.eligibility: Never call guessed or correlation-derived velocities measurements. A fixed rigid interface is a conditional transfer test to a liquid drop. Missing geometry/thermophysical inputs and unsteady/nonterminal conditions must be flagged.
flow.success: Do not call flow validated if grid/domain sensitivity exceeds the discrepancy or interface assumptions remain unmatched. Publish all results, including failures.

outcome_policy: Numerical implementation fixes may follow verification failures and must be logged. No tuning to empirical targets. New-to-project comparison is not equivalent to an untouched model-selection holdout or universal validation.
